title: Temperature limitation.
officialText:
Where a combination potable water-heating and space-heating system requires water for
space heating at temperatures higher than 140°F (60°C), a temperature actuated mixing valve that conforms to ANSI/ASSE
1017 shall be provided to temper the water supplied to the potable hot water distribution system to a temperature of 140°F
(60°C) or less.
